definitions.gloss: to ride, to get on, to board
definitions.explanation: To get onto a vehicle or mount something. Used for trains, buses, cars, bicycles, horses, etc.

examples.japanese: {電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}ります。
{自転車|じてんしゃ}に{乗|の}れますか？
タクシーに{乗|の}りましょう。

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {自動詞|じどうし} (intransitive). No pair verb. Pattern: Xに{乗|の}る (ride/get on X).

ASPECT: ている indicates resulting state. {乗|の}っている = 'is riding' or 'is on (vehicle).'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{電車|でんしゃ}に{乗|の}る (get on a train)
・{自転車|じてんしゃ}に{乗|の}る (ride a bicycle)
・{馬|うま}に{乗|の}る (ride a horse)
・{乗|の}り{換|か}える (to transfer)

Uses に particle. Opposite: {降|お}りる (to get off).

Related: {乗|の}り{物|もの} (vehicle).
